At BETA Technologies, we apply our intellectual curiosity, passion for aviation, and commitment to sustainability toward a shared mission of revolutionizing electric aviation. Regardless of the position one holds, each team member brings their talent and desire to positively impact the environment and lives of others in a refreshing, vibrant, and inclusive culture.
The Customer Product Team is looking for a full stack software engineer to help us build the next generation of digital aircraft and charging products. As a software engineer you’ll collaborate with our Maintenance, Flight Ops, Ground Service Equipment, and Data teams as well as work directly with our customers. This role requires equal parts engineering depth and interpersonal skill: you will build trust with non-technical stakeholders, translate ambiguous problems into clear technical designs, and ship high-quality software in a fast-moving environment. This role will focus on building out our data product capabilities as well as supporting our digital product platform.
How you will contribute to revolutionizing electric aviation:
Design, develop, and deploy full-stack web applications, internal tools, and APIs that address real customer needs
Leverage an AI first approach to accelerate development and build intelligent products
Evaluate, recommend, and implement new technologies and tools to improve efficiency
Drive innovation and continuous improvement in the development process
Translate complex, ambiguous requirements from non-technical stakeholders into clear technical designs and working solutions
Assess technical feasibility of proposed requirements and communicate tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders
Maintain technical documentation to facilitate knowledge transfer and long-term adoption of solutions
Participate in cross team software guild(s) to improve Beta’s software organization
Develop and collaborate with Software Architecture Leads to maintain long term technical designs and roadmaps
Work with a team of software engineers to delivery high quality code in a regular release cadence
Acknowledge and learn from past mistakes, fostering a culture of continuous improvement
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
3-5 years of professional software engineering experience
Experience with agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex)
Proficiency in modern full-stack development (e.g., React/TypeScript)
Experience with serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda and Fargate
Experience with modern web frameworks (ex: TanStack Start, NextJS, etc.)
Experience with AWS CDK
Experience with REST APIs, databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), and cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines
Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage multiple priorities, and adapt rapidly to changing requirements
Above and Beyond Qualifications:
Previous experience at a startup or in a fast-paced, resource-constrained environment
Experience building internal tools and enterprise applications
Experience in aerospace , manufacturing, or a regulated industry
Track record of identifying, scoping, and delivering projects with minimal direction
